stanzas.text:
The owner of the house

Carries the blame and its burdens

But a homeowner should be reliable

Leaders are disgusted by neglect

They care for their people dearly

And ensure their protection

Let them fill their house with light

Calling their Creator to be the Head

Declaring their house God's House

A house abiding by God's Commandments

In God's Kingdom, the Kings are not rulers

They place themselves beneath their people

In God's Kingdom, the Kings are like servants

They seek after the benefit of their people

Indeed, Kings will face many adversities

But Kings have the strength of devotion

They do not give up and survive many threats

So support those who humble themselves

Seeking to do good and be helpful

For those ones will guide the people with heart

Remain on your guard against sinful leaders

For they are slaves to sin and evil

They are not slaves of God or of people

### Supporting Verses

- "But Jesus called them unto Him and said, “Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them. But it shall not be so among you; but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister; and whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your slave (servant, not literal), even as the Son of Man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give His life as a ransom for many.”" - Matthew 20:25-28
- “Jesus answered them, “Very truly, I tell you, everyone who commits sin is a slave to sin. The slave does not have a permanent place in the household; the son has a place there forever. So if the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed” - John 8:34-36
- “But it shall not be so among you; but whoever would be great among you must be your servant, and whoever would be first among you must be slave of all.” - Mark 10:43-44

The People are intimate

Most of them are sexually inclined

Grief and sorrow, trauma and damage

These are (often) the fruits of sexual sin (life-changing events)

Love and intimacy, affection and closeness

These are fruits of sexual righteousness

Become familiar with what Our Father detests

In Him seek safety from the consequences of sin

By force or despite a refusal, one does not desist a sexual provocation

That person is guilty of rape, this is a heinous sin

One makes sexual advances upon his siblings or parents or children

That person is guilty of incest, this is a heinous sin

Disregarding age and innocence, one makes sexual advances on the prepubescent

That person is guilty of child molestation, this is a heinous sin

More than this, it is honorable to abide by the Law of the Land

Disregarding sexual exclusivity, one seeks sexual pleasure outside ones commitment

That person is guilty of adultery, this is a heinous sin

Do not invite those seducers to your bed, do not look at them lustfully

You shall have safety from the penalty if they trap you in sin

Having sex aimlessly, one who has sex without commitment

That person is guilty of fornication, it is a wasteful act

Indeed, group fornication is also displeasing to God

And people should also not display their sexual acts in public

Your commitment can be confirmed by time or legal bond

But one who transgresses creates carnage

That person leaves damage in their wake

By His Holy name, respect privacy in your sexual engagements

Engage behind closed doors and always assure mutual desire

As a believer, ask forgiveness for your past sins

Turn from these sins, and you may be spared the penalty

How can a penalty be enjoyable?

Could a man of God find them pleasing?

Surely, he would consider them rare and unhappy

God's Children value mercy above all law

They use mercy to provide for the people

And they give it as an offering to God

Pray that you receive foresight

For penalties can break and fester evils

And adding them wrongly may be inhumane

Do not add them without warning

Do not add them to some over others

Be fair and true in your dealings

Knowing that the measure would be due you

If you had done what they had done

For you are of knowledge enough

Disorder is not worth a lack of punishment

Authorities set the laws and rules

They direct people to uphold them

Their subjects approve of their governance

For they lack the means to uphold any law

Yet assign authority only to the trustworthy

For they cause grief and sin when they work

Knowing that a people cannot defend themselves

But that a measure is certainly due (the criminals)

Remember, God is Highest in His Kingdom!

Look, even the animals are subordinate to Him!

Your brothers and sisters are weak like you

They go astray from time to time

The understanding do not shun others

They would not tell others how to feel

The understanding would not judge by their own deeds

They would not expect others to act like themselves

God's Children show understanding

Consider your background and past

Think of your hardships and weaknesses

We are gentle and thoughtful of each other

### Supporting Verses

- “If the world hates you, keep in mind that it hated me first. If you belonged to the world, it would love you as its own. As it is, you do not belong to the world, but I have chosen you out of the world. That is why the world hates you.” - John 15:18-19

The selfless seek not their own lives

They do not work to fill their own accounts

The wise see the error in their ways

But fools believe they did nothing wrong

Be humble enough to blame yourself when fights arise

While others may focus on what they did right

Have courage and do not be afraid

The truth will vindicate those it chooses

The self-serving will avoid liability

Until a full accounting has been made known

People have dirty hair and bodies

They have disease and sicknesses

Even some hidden away within their hearts

Put on them by what happened before

Others will turn away and become shy

Those made similar to them have become estranged

For the Earth and its ways have overtaken them

Yet there is One who has overcome the World

Our Master and Teacher, the Chosen One of God

It was Jesus who was called Doctor and Healer

He would touch the sick with open palms

With unwashed hands He would eat food

And He would spend His time with sinners

Jesus would teach of Heavenly things few understood

He spoke in parables which were too amazing to comprehend

Yet it was not the righteous but the sick who He spoke to

Do as Jesus commands and follow His Word with intention

That is the way to God's wishes and pleasures

### Supporting Verses

- “For out of the heart come evil thoughts—murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, slander. These are what defile a person; but eating with unwashed hands does not defile them.” - Matthew 15:19-20
- "On hearing this, Jesus said to them, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”" - Mark 2:17

> Don't fight within or against yourself
> Don't fight with your neighbors
> Don't fight with your opponents
> Don't fight with your family
> Don't fight with your friends
> Don't fight with arms
> Don't fight with words
> Don't even fight with the dart of an eye or a smile

Jesus taught us to return hate with love

Indeed, he blessed the peacemakers

For they are the Children of God

Peaceful ways are found by the selfless

They are on the side of the truth

Those who quarrel and lead wars should be cast away

And to the peaceful be granted all authority

They settle matters and seek compromise

By God's guidance, they seek diplomacy

Revenge is far from them, unprofitable and in ruin

They surrender to their enemies

And provide understanding for their wishes

They put their distaste to the side

By tolerating that which they detest

They sow little disgruntlement

By avoiding provocative words

And allow contrary opinions

So that they may have peace with their own

Even evil, violent attacks

It disturbs them not

For they nurture peace ahead of themselves

### Supporting Verses

- "Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God." - Matthew 5:9
- "Settle matters quickly with your adversary who is taking you to court." - Matthew 5:25

God, Our Father has sent the Gospel

He has called those in conflict to peace

And it is not the prosecution of your opposers

That He desires you place your hopes on

Rather, place your thoughts on the next life

And foresee the reward of His Children

Acknowledge a person's progress

Give to them for their righteousness

Surely, when Jesus comes again

He will reward everyone for their deeds

When one has only done what is expected

Give them relief from their burdens

When one has proven himself trustworthy

Provide him with privilege, and others likewise

Discipline is not the first choice of the wise

A reward is always considered by the mindful

### Supporting Verses

- “Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of me. Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets who were before you.” - Matthew 5:11-12

Trust spreads its seed all around

You shall have growth in every corner

Trust shall multiply again and again

Each year building on the last

Deception and concealment trap many

Choking the growth, sowing distrust

A trusting person senses no malice in others

He suspects no sinister intent

He believes that others speak the truth

And he speaks the truth himself

A trusting person has decent expectations of others

He takes their words lightly and in a good way

Even upon the wicked people and evil doers

He shall believe a righteous cause

Until evidence is provided to the contrary

Or a lie is revealed plainly

So he should also trust in Our God

Blindfolded or without air to breathe

He shall have confidence in his escape

Set to a hardship or long trial

He shall have faith in his triumph

Carrying the burdens of God is hard

Even without those who seek your harm

Serving God closely brings on hate

You will find yourself with enemies

They will scoff at you and belittle you

They will delegitimize you and set traps for you

Those who hate you may seek your harm

They will exceed the bounds you expected

But do not turn towards hate or anger

Even when they are constant in their attacks

When they are harsh and unrelenting

Pray to God, seek His strength, and persevere

Our Creator never forgets his faithful servants

Have faith, and He will not leave you behind

### Supporting Verses

- "You will be hated by everyone because of me, but the one who stands firm to the end will be saved." - Matthew 10:22
- "Blessed are you when people hate you, when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil, because of the Son of Man." - Luke 6:22
- "If the world hates you, keep in mind that it hated me first." - John 15:18
- "If you belonged to the world, it would love you as its own. As it is, you do not belong to the world, but I have chosen you out of the world. That is why the world hates you." - John 15:19
- "The world cannot hate you, but it hates me because I testify that its works are evil." - John 7:7

Evil people are hard to understand

They act unpredictably

They commit horrible atrocities

Many of them are filled with demons

Completely insane, under their own torture

Yet even within the most heinous

There is light

Indeed, God cares for not only the righteous

Rather, he cares for all the living

Even the wicked

Let not those who save lives

Credit their passion to their pain

Remember those who destroy lives

Truly, they credit their pain as well

The demons are sadistic liars

Their father is the inventor of sin

Torturers share both hands with Satan

Possessors of people share their bed with him

Whoever steals people's free will

That one has done the most heinous

And created a tragedy worse than death

Such people are in severe danger of Hell

They may never escape the rulers of their new home

Where the authorities take endless joy in their suffering

Yet the helpless will be given amazing honor

Infinite abundance and overflowing love from all over

And the Presence of the Almighty will heal their souls

Only the slave owners who turn away from their sin

Who receive justice and the due penalty on Earth

May have comfort on the day of reckoning

Our Father created each person

Each one an individual

He gave us minds and hearts of our own

To make the choice between right and wrong

Indeed, He provides for you a finite environment

Within which He provides space to choose

From which He shall judge your heart

By His guiding words,

Our Creator shaped the Earth

And by His Supreme Commands

He determines what He wishes

Why fear losing along the way?

Knowing your Father is with you

Be not afraid of anyone

Not even of yourself

Few are capable of very much

Except that it be stopped

Have courage and be brave

Your Father will answer your call

And His knowledge is complete

Glory and destruction in His design

Are both only 7 precise steps away

Amazing God, Who Heals People!

Righteous Creator, Who Sends Rain!

### Supporting Verses

- “I have told you these things, so that in me you may have peace. In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.” - John 16:33
- "Then Jesus said to him, “Get up! Pick up your mat and walk.” At once the man was cured; he picked up his mat and walked." - John 5:8-9

Life is full of fleeting distractions

The Earth itself makes promises it cannot keep

The surface reveals little of what is within

While the petty things demand much

Remember that which feeds the soul

Truly it is the Word of God

Surely it is love and the next life

So do not let the attractive things persuade you

Neither dishonor people for small wrongs

But appreciate the weighty matters

And celebrate that which is worthy

What is life at all,

If you have nothing to remember?

Why should a child have no where to turn,

Crying out, “Father, help! God, save me!”

Words cannot describe the pain

Even images cannot depict the horror

For suffering is a private experience

Let those with food eat it

So that they may not be tired

Make them not lazy or over restful,

Give them empathy for hardship

There is pain in the work

There are struggles and costs

But be grateful amidst your pain

And deliver relief to the others

Give your life by devoting it to giving back

Lay it down by your work

And build God's Kingdom on Earth

Taking part in the Salvation of Jesus

Come to God with wisdom

Approach Him humbly

He does not lead all people

The one who gets excited by money

Or the one full of dreams and fantasies

About riches or fame or Earthly success

He shows love and uplifts His Chosen

Who heed guidance selflessly

Who dream of giving back

And expect nothing in return

Our Father will strengthen them,

He will help and deliver them!

People and angels have honored many gifts

Some a fraction, some a tenth, others a third

Some say to give what's left beyond needs

Yet God does not ask any of these of you

Almighty God, in all His Power, calls you out

He asks that you give all you have to the poor

Do it all at once, and then follow Jesus

Yes, be generous whenever you can

But don't be deceived by wealth and life

Be not afraid at all

For not only will you survive your gift

Even more, you shall truly find your own life

Even when you doubt, Jesus shall catch you

Truly, the one who gives all will see the Power of God

But what of the single parents,

What about the children?

What of those whose hearts are not ready?

Certainly, Your Father will always accept your gift

Yet begin work for His sake, and when you do,

Do not turn back

Praise God!

He doesn't want to place His sheep in danger

So do not let the old ways of travel be your means of travel

For some there was a donkey, for others a camel

For us there is both the vehicle and the internet

Give your provision, your resources

Give your time, your knowledge

Be a knowledgeable servant

Hide away from the public eye

Let your giving be in secret

So God may reward you in Paradise

And your gift may be between you and Him

### Supporting Verses

- “Jesus answered, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me.” - Matthew 19:21
- “But Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, “Look, Lord! Here and now I give half of my possessions to the poor, and if I have cheated anybody out of anything, I will pay back four times the amount.” Jesus said to him, “Today salvation has come to this house, because this man, too, is a son of Abraham.” - Luke 19:8-9
- “But when you give to the needy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing, so that your giving may be in secret. Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.” - Matthew 6:3-4
- “Give to the one who asks you, and do not turn away from the one who wants to borrow from you.” - Matthew 5:42
- “So when you give to the needy, do not announce it with trumpets, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by others. Truly I tell you, they have received their reward in full.” - Matthew 6:2
- “So do not worry, saying, ‘What shall we eat?' or ‘What shall we drink?' or ‘What shall we wear?' For the pagans run after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them. But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.” - Matthew 6:31-33
- "The one who works his land will have plenty of food, but whoever chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty. A faithful man will abound with blessings, but one eager to be rich will not go unpunished." - Proverbs 28:18-19

Our God is greater than all things,

He exalts the humble and the small,

He brings the poor up from down low,

and brings the lost into the light

His Will is greater than that of people

He has knowledge of all secrets and truths

Our God is a good God, for He shows both mercy and love

He is also generous, whether that be in this life or the next

Indeed, He saves the one who calls out to Him

He has power to turn the evil toward the light

For Our God is a good God, and many are saved in death

He has created the Next Life, the Earth, and all things Unseen,

He has made some things enjoyable, even miracles

Yet His Presence is the Ultimate Reward, our greatest hope

May He grant godspeed to the one who is patient,

May He grant glory to the one who seeks God's

May He grant riches to the one who seeks goodness,

May He grant peace to the peaceful

May He grant happiness to the one who seeks others,

Praise God in all His Might, nothing dictates against Him

### Supporting Verses

- "Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over, will be poured into your lap. For with the measure you use, it will be measured to you." - Luke 6:38
- "I tell you that this man, rather than the other, went home justified before God. For all those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted." - Luke 18:14
- “But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you, that you may be children of your Father in heaven. He causes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.” - Matthew 5:44-45

> **Prayer of Virtue:**
> When I fight, help me to not fight
> When I am impatient, help me to be patient
> When I am proud, help me to be humble
> When I am wild, help me into self-control
> When I hold grudges, help me to release them
> When I am angry, help me to find inner peace
> When I deceive others, help me to purify myself
> Amen

The People are blessed with power

Power to speak inwardly and to be heard

Our God listens to what is not spoken aloud

And He knows when you acknowledge Him in your heart
It is a power called prayer, it is one of His great joys

Prayer should be honest and true

He desires not that you hide from Him

Be genuine about your hardships

Praying earnestly about your hopes and wishes

Be loving, giving Him your praise and thanks

Do not pray with many words

One can speak to Him in a moment

Another may spend a while in stillness

He listens to your heart, He knows what is unsaid

There are many different ways to pray

But it is the genuine who Our Father always accepts

Pray not for riches

Pray not for selfish gain

Our Father loves prayers to gain virtue

He answers prayers which help others

The one who makes a prayer for the right things

Only needs a dash of faith for it all to come true

One who calls out to the Creator longs for Him secretly

He hears their cry and shows them mercy

Yet it is the loving time obeying His Gospel,

And the regular prayer which grows your relationship

Our Father loves our dedicated time alone with Him

Whether once, three, or five times a day

Give Him time in prayer, in worship, or in study

Indeed, it is not too much, it is due Him

### Supporting Verses

- "And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites, for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by others." - Matthew 6:5
- "And when you pray, do not keep on babbling like pagans, for they think they will be heard because of their many words. Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask him." - Matthew 6:7-8

Indeed, Our God had a Son who lived on Earth

He was selfless and full of love and peace

Yet he lived a life of poverty and difficulty

Yes, Our Father chose One to be called His Own

And the One chosen called us brothers and sisters

His name is Jesus Christ

The Holy Lamb who was slain

Jesus is the coming Lord over All Earth

The compassionate Savior of mankind

Created since before creation, the living Gospel

A truth which was true before time and now

He is the first messenger of the Gospel

The One who healed the multitudes

The only direct way to the Creator, Our Father

And the one called Life-Giving Messiah

The Prophets labored hard in the fields

But Jesus brings life to the People

Indeed, Jesus always brought life

From his earliest years as a young one

He astounded those who listened

And he amazed elders at his teaching

But Jesus power was not only in his teaching

For he had the Creator on his side

He confidently performed feats of healing

With authority he rid people of their sickness

Before long, crowds began to follow him

But he said, the glory is God's, and it was

Yet it was Jesus that God had confirmed

By giving him such power in the sight of others

In time, Jesus teachings were collected

They were shared with passion and devotion

Now, these poems share his message once again

Along with other teachings of science and wisdom

Who can describe faith with words?

Can any language describe it?

Faith cannot be trapped in a bottle

Faith cannot be seen with the naked eye

Only by what it touches and leaves behind

Might you possibly spot its presence

When faith is present in a person

Can anybody put a stop to them?

Nay, except for momentary illusions

With faith, what is not possible for a person?

One can heal in unexplainable ways

One can move the unmovable objects

Indeed, with faith all things are possible

Faith is found in the good decisions of people

Faith itself is an undoubtful belief in God

And knowing that He will do what you believe

The one who stands firm to the very end

That is the one who Our Father notices

Definitely, He will not leave that one unfulfilled

Feelings and numbness

Knowledge and ignorance

What can they do to faith?

Do they have any power?

Perhaps it is the fire or the storm

Which desires to overcome faith

Can even death overcome faith?

### Supporting Verses

- "Truly I tell you, if you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,' and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you" - Matthew 17:20
- "Jesus replied, “Truly I tell you, if you have faith and do not doubt, not only can you do what was done to the fig tree, but also you can say to this mountain, ‘Go, throw yourself into the sea,' and it will be done. If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.”" - Matthew 21:21

Our Creator sees what we are unaware of

He forgives and shows us mercy every day

Yet He does not forgive the unforgiving people

So Jesus taught us to forgive with strength

Pay close attention to yourself

Resentment has been the captor of many

Revenge and penalty a common pit

Forgiveness is from the heart

It speaks not a word against anyone

It seeks out the best of memories

Even when the pains are great

God desires that you forgive

Even when you're too weak to keep forgiving

God wants you to pray for strength

Yes, it is your constancy in forgiveness

Which brings Our Father to approval

Indeed, Our God loves to forgive those who forgive

He will not hold those forgiven to account

### Supporting Verses

- "For if you forgive other people when they sin against you, your heavenly Father will also forgive you. But if you do not forgive others their sins, your Father will not forgive your sins." - Matthew 6:14-15

Jesus spoke God's Word

And he gave commands from God

Yet only few commands were given

To love your God is the greatest commandment

One without wisdom can live by it

Our God exalts love above all knowledge

Indeed, love your Creator ahead of all things

Truly He is your Father and looks after you

What can be more important than Him?

He's the Good One who is always there for you

And love those who cross your path

Have compassion for their hardship

Overlook their wrongs and help them

For love is the most pleasing to your Father

Indeed, love is the most powerful force

It can drive people across the whole earth

And love can heal a person's inner self

So manifest love in its many forms

And you will be greater than a monk or priest

Treat your opposers like friends

Remind them their Creator loves them also

Indeed, Our God is greater than wars and grudges

His Love is not hampered by our mutual grievances

Relieve the load for another

And take on suffering as love

Labor for their health

Give them your time

And what you value

This example Jesus set for us

By giving his life so we could have ours

Pray for love in all your words

Pray for love in all that you do

Speak pleasantly unto others

Speak the truth

Be not two-faced

Choose gentle words

Search out the light in people

Find the good in what they do

Be empathetic out of your love

Give thought to others feelings

Consider their perspectives

Show you feel what they feel

Love may consist of doing good deeds

Yet the deepest love is unconditional

Those with God's Love in their hearts,

Give love without it being earned

Be not partial to anyone

Give love to the unloved

Give attention to the forgotten

Forgive the pariah

### Supporting Verses

- "This is My command to you: Love one another." - John 15:17
- "But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you, that you may be children of your Father in heaven." - Matthew 5:44-45
- "Jesus replied: “‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.' This is the first and greatest commandment. And the second is like it: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.'" - Matthew 22:37-39

> Relieve all people from their poverty,
> Glorify our God across the world

How easy it is to honor an excellent person

But the mirror is full of disapproval

Might you despise yourself for your life?

Yet your Creator loves your soul more than body

The body finds itself in decay

Strength is given way, time is poured

A food unlike the fruits, a poisonous berry

Patiently, you eat, slowly, it also eats

Oneself is low but also high

Indulging in the seductive taste

Coming back to drink and to buy

Gaining now, and losing later

Returning again and again

To give your health, to pay the premium

This is addiction, one of Satan's dreams

What is worth little shall cost you much

Our Creator is the greatest scientist

He has knowledge of the smallest things

So be mindful of what is around you

Also be mindful of your own body

Indeed, be watchful over your whole health

And eat what is safe and nourishing

Wouldn't it be heartbreaking not to care for yourself

And to find your body wasting away

Awaiting a slow death, slow to appear?

But science drives machines

And machines in turn provide your harvest

So be conscious of science

Humbly accepting the truth as it is

Our Father is not pleased by drunkenness

He does not like outbursts or aggression

Nor does He love sleeping all the time

One should walk and talk carefully

Avoiding heavy drugs and overuse

Such drugs are intended for doctors

Others lose strength, but keep victims

One should choose what to take with patience,

And should remain in control of themselves

Our Father is the poor's advocate

He helps the helpless

Without Him, tyrants would rage on

The unheard would have no voice

When the quake is great

And the devastation moreso

Strongmen are broke to pieces

And thoughts long forgotten

Will return to nurture evils

Without strength, who can overcome?

Full of pride, who can please God?

Indeed, He is near the weak and loves them

Yet through prayer He will strengthen you

God Overcomes All,

God Bestows All Strength!

O, Father, help the stranded one

Help those taken by calamity

Hurricanes lay homes to ruin

The wildfire leaves ash behind

Indeed, the chronic pains are weighty

Just as the horrors and their traumas

Like the winds and rains raged inside

Causing all sorts of inner loss

The victim is left to rebuild

Given only examples of evil

Numb to all sorts of hurtful things

The loving will understand

A victim's unrighteous ways

Form no godly basis for judgement

Darkness always comes in time

We all grieve in time, for the Earth is no home

Our past haunts us even today

Hardships last far past their hope

Is the Earth just crumbling rock?

Is there no sense in what happens to us?

Nay, God Directs All Things!

All The Sand and All The Snow!

Might I fail in an endeavor

God prepares me for another

Might I lose my shelter

God keeps for me a blanket

Might I never find true love

God shows His Love instead

Missing what you have lost

Remembering what you never had

Trials call for more than you have

What you have calls for more love

There is no strength or desire

Your Father calls you away

Away from the whole world

Indeed, it is a futile place

Few escape Earth's suffering

Your Creator calls you to Him

Where trials lose their power

And what you've had pales in comparison

Unlike eternal life and His Love

For your God is a caring Creator

He is filled with sorrow at your suffering

So give to others and call upon Him

He is always near and complete in knowledge

God's Children do like the Angels

Greater in heart and in mind, full of love

Attacks and traps do not distract them

They be kind, they wish blessings in return

Long sentences doom not His faithful

They will pray for patience and strength

Though they will become numb to their pain

Without declining, but bearing good fruit

Be not in despair at all

Darkness doesn't teach

But its victims do learn

Take heed of simple corrections

And do good amidst tribulations

Even taking on pain all day and night

Speak not empty words, but God's Word

Your trial will test you in some way

So always return to His Will

God will send you relief

He will give it where you do not expect it

The fire will boil your inner self
